## How `tiptap.mjs` was built

In a temporary directory (not part of the repository): `npm install @tiptap/core @tiptap/pm @tiptap/starter-kit @tiptap/extension-table @tiptap/extension-task-list @tiptap/extension-task-item @tiptap/extension-highlight @tiptap/extension-text-align @tiptap/extension-placeholder @tiptap/extension-link @tiptap/extension-underline esbuild`, then an entry file re-exporting what the tab uses:

```js
export { Editor, Extension, Node, Mark, mergeAttributes, generateHTML, getSchema } from '@tiptap/core';
export { default as StarterKit } from '@tiptap/starter-kit';
export { Table, TableRow, TableHeader, TableCell } from '@tiptap/extension-table';
export { TaskList } from '@tiptap/extension-task-list';
export { TaskItem } from '@tiptap/extension-task-item';
export { Highlight } from '@tiptap/extension-highlight';
export { TextAlign } from '@tiptap/extension-text-align';
export { Placeholder } from '@tiptap/extension-placeholder';
export { Plugin, PluginKey, TextSelection } from '@tiptap/pm/state';
export { Decoration, DecorationSet } from '@tiptap/pm/view';
```

and `npx esbuild entry.mjs --bundle --format=esm --minify --legal-comments=none --outfile=tiptap.mjs` (the header comment was prepended). The core, the worlds and the engine never import this file; only `ui/tabs/editor/view.mjs` does.
